params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: formula
params.description: 4D formula (instruction, Formula-editor formula, command call, or project method call) to associate with the column.

params.name: dataType
params.description: Type of the value produced by evaluating formula.

overloads.semanticRole: Changes the formula associated with the designated list box column.

constraints: Formula-driven columns require the list box's Data Source to be Current Selection, Named Selection, or Collection or Entity Selection.
object must designate a list box column.
